items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I guess I haven't seen him in years.

ctx.x: Yeah, I love your tune so much. That's why, and I like Triangle Jazz Blues, all those. I noticed there's no repeats on it, you just played each string once. Yeah, yeah. And that was it, straight down, huh?
Yeah, and what you call a player, of course he didn't play it the way I wrote it, of course he possibly improvised, you know. Allman.
Allman, yeah. Yeah, of course he would.
